name: Koutoubia Mosque
description: A 12th-century minaret dominates Marrakesh’s skyline beside Jemaa el-Fnaa.

name: Hassan II Mosque
description: A vast seaside mosque with a towering minaret on Casablanca’s Atlantic edge.

name: Bab Bou Jeloud
description: The ornate Blue Gate opens into Fes el-Bali’s medina.

name: Aït Benhaddou
description: A fortified ksar of earthen buildings on a former caravan route.

name: Kasbah of Chefchaouen
description: A restored kasbah museum sits in the blue medina’s main square.

name: Jemaa el-Fnaa
description: A square of storytellers, juice stalls and evening food smoke.

name: Erg Chebbi dunes
description: Golden dunes near Merzouga for camel treks and desert camps.

name: Todra Gorge
description: Sheer canyon walls rise above a river road in the High Atlas east.

name: Essaouira ramparts
description: Atlantic medina walls and a harbour of blue boats.

name: Volubilis
description: Roman ruins of mosaics and arches in the Moroccan countryside.

name: Jemaa el-Fnaa food stalls
description: Night stalls serve grilled meats, snails and orange juice on the square.

name: Fes medina food streets
description: Street kitchens and cafés weave through Fes el-Bali near the tanneries.

name: Central Market Casablanca
description: A covered market for produce and casual bites downtown.

name: Rabat medina souks
description: Souk streets sell olives, pastries and street snacks near the kasbah.

name: Tangier café streets
description: Historic cafés and pastry shops in the medina and Ville Nouvelle.

name: Tan-Tan Moussem
description: A large Saharan tribal gathering of markets, camels and music (UNESCO-listed).
